label: Connect your AI screen: every word

params.name: lede
params.default: Let an AI app you use - Claude, ChatGPT - work in {product} for you, for tests and demos: look things up and press the same buttons you would, as you. Signing in, payments and other people's steps stay with people.
params.label: lede

params.name: step1_note
params.default: Claude: Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector. ChatGPT: Settings, Connectors, Create.
params.label: step1_note

params.name: step2_note
params.default: Use the Copy button below; give it any name you like.
params.label: step2_note

params.name: step3_note
params.default: A window opens on this site - sign in with your normal account and press Allow. Nothing to type, no key to copy.
params.label: step3_note

params.name: label_ph
params.default: Name it after the app, such as Claude on my laptop
params.label: label_ph

params.name: no_keys
params.default: No keys yet. Make one to connect an AI app.
params.label: no_keys

params.name: revoke_body
params.default: An AI app using this key stops working at once. You can make a new key any time.
params.label: revoke_body

params.name: command_label
params.default: For Claude Code - run this once
params.label: command_label

params.name: command_note
params.default: Other apps: add a remote MCP server with the address above and the header Authorization: Bearer and your key.
params.label: command_note

params.name: tools
params.default: What an AI app can do
params.label: tools

params.name: tools_note
params.default: Each tool is one of {product}'s own buttons. Reads look things up; changes press a button; a person does the rest. Each tool is gated by People & access under Connect your AI.
params.label: tools_note

params.name: check_tip
params.default: Runs a real question through the server and says which step fails, if any
params.label: check_tip

params.name: disconnect_body
params.default: That AI app stops at once. You can connect it again any time.
params.label: disconnect_body

params.name: dev_note
params.default: Prefer a key? Make one here for an app that cannot sign in (Claude Code, a script). It is shown once.
params.label: dev_note

params.name: allow_title
params.default: Allow {app} to work in {product} as you?
params.label: allow_title

params.name: allow_body
params.default: {app} will be able to use the tools on Connect your AI - look things up and press the same buttons you would - as you. Signing in, payments and other people's steps stay with people. You can disconnect it any time on this screen.
params.label: allow_body
